The NMOS load has its gate at VDD, so its gm contributes nothing at the output and f3dB would be set by weak gds. The bulk error is also a real problem. I'll switch to a PMOS diode load (source and bulk at VDD, gate and drain at the output). Its gm provides the ≥1.85 mS output conductance the 590 MHz bandwidth needs, and it has no body effect.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "NMOS load with gate at VDD is AC-grounded, so its gm does not load the output and f3dB cannot reach 590 MHz. Its bulk also violated the vss rule. Replacing it with a PMOS diode load (bulk at VDD) gives gtot about 5 mS and gain about 1.5. Vout is solved by bisection at each corner and supply.", "params": {"gmid_n": 15.0, "L_n": 0.5, "gmid_p": 8.0, "L_p": 0.5, "I": 0.5e-3}}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_n": (15.0, 9.0, 18.0),           # signal nFET gm/Id [S/A]
    "L_n": (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),                # signal nFET length [um]
    "gmid_p": (8.0, 6.0, 11.0),            # PMOS diode-load gm/Id [S/A]
    "L_p": (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),                # PMOS load length [um]
    "I": (0.5e-3, 0.25e-3, 1.0e-3),        # branch current [A]
}

VDD_NOM, VDD_MIN, VDD_MAX = 1.8, 1.62, 1.98
CORNERS = [("tt", 27), ("ss", 125), ("ss", -40), ("ff", -40),
           ("ff", 125), ("sf", 27), ("fs", 27)]


def _solve_vout(L_, m1, Ln, mp, Lp, vdd_c, vcm):
    """Bisection on Vout. Ip(Vsg = vdd - vout) falls as vout rises; In(vout) rises."""
    lo, hi = 0.05, vdd_c - 0.05
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        In = L_.op("n", m1.W, Ln, vcm, vds=mid)["Id"]
        Ip = L_.op("p", mp.W, Lp, vdd_c - mid, vds=vdd_c - mid)["Id"]
        if Ip > In:      # load too strong -> Vout must rise
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)


def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    vcm = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 20e-6)
    I = p["I"]

    # Sizing from intent
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], I, vds=0.6)   # CS amplifier device
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I, vds=0.9)   # PMOS diode load
    mb = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)            # reference sink

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1)            # common-source NMOS
    # PMOS diode load: gate = drain = vout, source = bulk = vdd (no body effect)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vout", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("Mb", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)         # reference sink

    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m2.cdd

    gain_wc, f3db_wc, gbw_wc = 1e9, 1e9, 1e9
    vout_lo = 1e9
    swing_wc, head_wc = 1e9, 1e9

    for corner, temp in CORNERS:
        L_ = lut.at(corner, temp)
        for vdd_c in (VDD_MIN, VDD_MAX):
            vout = _solve_vout(L_, m1, p["L_n"], m2, p["L_p"], vdd_c, vcm)
            a = L_.op("n", m1.W, p["L_n"], vcm, vds=vout)
            b = L_.op("p", m2.W, p["L_p"], vdd_c - vout, vds=vdd_c - vout)

            # Output conductance: PMOS load gm (diode) + both gds. Bulk = source -> no gmb.
            gtot_c = b["gm"] + b["gds"] + a["gds"]
            gain_c = a["gm"] / gtot_c
            f_c = gtot_c / (2 * PI * cout)
            gbw_c = a["gm"] / (2 * PI * cout)

            gain_wc = min(gain_wc, gain_c)
            f3db_wc = min(f3db_wc, f_c)
            gbw_wc = min(gbw_wc, gbw_c)
            vout_lo = min(vout_lo, vout)
            head_wc = min(head_wc, vout - a["vdsat"])

            # Symmetric peak-to-peak swing about vout, bounded by M1 triode edge
            # and PMOS load cutoff (Vout max = VDD - |Vth_p|).
            half = min(vout - a["vdsat"], vdd_c - b["vth"] - vout)
            swing_wc = min(swing_wc, 2 * half)

    power_mw = 1e3 * VDD_MAX * (I + iref)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(gain_wc),
        "f3db": f3db_wc / 1e6,      # MHz
        "gbw": gbw_wc / 1e6,        # MHz
        "power": power_mw,          # mW
        "vout_dc": vout_lo,         # V, worst (lowest) DC level
        "swing": swing_wc,          # V, peak-to-peak
        "headroom_n": head_wc,      # V, worst Vout - Vdsat(M1)
    }
```
